g.text: Pair 80 · Optical flow · saved analytic derivative
Pair 100 · Optical flow · saved analytic derivative
Cartesian derivatives displayed against depth below the local surface. Gray = unavailable. The two methods have different smoothing.
OF and PIV share a color scale across both pairs; differences use their own scale. Limits = 99th percentile of absolute values; extremes remain in data.
PIV differentiation precedes surface-depth sampling. The supplied PIV does not initialize or alter optical flow. Physical units and surface offset are assumed.
